patch.summary: folk cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: folk pricing is plan-gated across 4 researched tiers. Free entry: Free. 14-day trial documented. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.title: folk plan matrix and who each tier suits
blocks.body: Structure and trial/free flags come from SoftwareGlimpse pricing research. Dollar amounts appear only when verified — never invent list prices.

lines.label: Free
lines.description: Free plan · 14-day trial · up to 1 seat · Suits: explore before committing seats

lines.label: Standard
lines.description: 14-day trial · Unlocks: contact management, lead management, pipeline management · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Premium
lines.description: 14-day trial · Unlocks: deal management, email sequences, reporting · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Enterprise
lines.description: 14-day trial · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

blocks.heading: folk cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price folk against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Free until a gated capability (contact management (Standard, Premium, Enterprise)) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (contact management, lead management, pipeline management) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Custom objects/Deals, email sequences, dashboards, workspace roles, and API access start on Premium.. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when Founders and SMB teams running relationship-led sales from LinkedIn/email requires a paid unlock you will use weekly
Do not overbuy if this limitation dominates: Custom objects/Deals, email sequences, dashboards, workspace roles, and API access start on Premium.
Side-by-side cost with Salesflare on the same seat count

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: Custom objects/Deals, email sequences, dashboards, workspace roles, and API access start on Premium.

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Enrichment, magic fields, and AI assistant credits are monthly capped by plan (custom on Enterprise).

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: FAQ references a free plan for downgrades, but live pricing cards emphasize Standard/Premium/Enterprise — free-tier feature limits are not fully documented on the pricing table.

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: Deals, sequences, dashboards, and API require Premium

blocks.title: Cheaper or clearer alternatives to pressure-test
blocks.body: Compare total cost of ownership vs folk on identical constraints.

blocks.title: Model crm spend with folk in mind
blocks.body: Use researched plan structure for folk alongside category cost modelling.
